title: operator-s3 chart values
description: Only the values whose wrong spelling would make the manager exit at startup or the pod unschedulable are checked; every other value is open.

imageRegistry.description: Registry host (and optional path prefix) the manager image is pulled from, for a mirror or an air-gapped cluster (EB-5).

digest.description: The image digest, sha256:<64 hex>; wins over tag (EB-5).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables of the manager container (EB-5: proxy and CA settings).

name.description: Not one of the variables the chart sets itself: a duplicate name would override it.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod Security restricted (EB-10) needs runAsNonRoot and a seccomp profile; the defaults set both.

securityContext.description: Pod Security restricted (EB-10): no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped; the defaults also make the root filesystem read-only.
